programs.title: Satoyama Kitchen Spring
programs.desc: Hi, it's me, Tama! Today, my humans, Grandpa Makoto and Grandma Nobuko, left wearing strange outfits. That's because they're going to pick himetake bamboo shoots with two experts. I hope they get enough for me, too.

programs.title: Journeys in Japan
programs.desc: . An insightful look at the many unique places to visit while traveling in Japan, as English-speaking travelers travel across the country, explore the culture, and meet some of the interesting locals, learning about some of its historic sights. Bill Sullivan, Kyle Card, Michael Keida, Dean Newcombe, James Lambiasi, Natsumi Nagaoka, Atsushi Takase, Yosuke Hosoi.
